forms.membership.description: Collects membership attestation and configured membership details, plus the applicant’s name, email address and phone number.
forms.eligibility.description: Collects residence, date of birth and other eligibility information for the member and any spouse or children applying for coverage.
forms.coverage.description: Collects work and income information, selected products, covered applicants, coverage amounts and product options.
forms.beneficiary.description: Collects beneficiary assignments, designations and percentage shares for the selected coverage.
forms.contact.description: Collects residential, business, correspondence and spouse contact information as applicable.
forms.profile.description: Collects personal information, physician details, existing insurance information and applicable financial questionnaire responses.
forms.review.description: Collects the acknowledgements and electronic consents required after reviewing the application summary.
forms.payment.description: Collects payment method, payment frequency, and bank account details for the requested coverage.
forms.dividend-notices.description: Collects acknowledgement, election and identity details for configured dividend notices (ABE is only site using this).
forms.resume-email-request.description: Collects the applicant email, or the advisor’s own email and phone after Continue identifies the applicant, to request a secure email link. Answers remain unavailable until phone verification succeeds.
forms.resume-delivery-method.description: Collects the selected delivery method for a saved-application verification code.
forms.advisor-login.description: Collects advisor contact details and access code for a new application, or the applicant’s email address for a saved application.
forms.docusign.description: Collects electronic signatures on the application documents through DocuSign.
forms.health-qd.description: Collects QuickDecision health questionnaire responses through external Magnum form.
forms.payment-credit-card.description: Collects card details through the payment provider’s hosted form when credit-card payment is offered.
forms.member-authentication.description: Collects identity-verification responses to authenticate an existing member through LexisNexis integration.
forms.dividend-notices.name: Dividend notices
forms.payment-credit-card.name: Credit card details
forms.member-authentication.name: Member authentication
forms.health-qd.name: Health (QD)
forms.health-questionnaires.name: Health (SI, TELE, DI SUPP, CIR)
forms.health-questionnaires.description: Collects health questionnaire responses and applicable follow-up details.
forms.member-verification.description: Collects the residential address and selected verification method, including the LexisNexis security-question option or the choice to skip verification. Form prior to Member authentication.
forms.resume-code.description: Collects a phone-delivered verification code in the portal to resume a saved application. Code delivery uses LexisNexis.
